items.title: 61529_Maxine Sullivan oral history interview
items.q: The interviewer mentions Irene Reid, but the interviewee (Maxine Sullivan) does not respond or provide any personal connection or interaction details regarding Irene Reid.

ctx.x: We were talking about Irene Reid playing on Boston Road, right here off 168th Street, she used sing with a group, Robert (inaudible) on piano who, if you heard him sing, sounds just like Nat King Cole. I'll tell you who else sounds just like Nat King Cole when he sings, Oscar Peterson.
